title: aspalathus zeyheri
intro: Aspalathus zeyheri, commonly known as the Red Bush or Rooibos, is a species of flowering plant in the legume family Fabaceae. This plant is native to South Africa and is traditionally used as an herbal tea, providing numerous health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and immune-boosting properties. The therapeutic actions of Aspalathus zeyheri include reducing oxidative stress, improving cardiovascular health, and alleviating symptoms of allergies and digestive issues. The bioactive constituents of Rooibos tea include aspalathin, a unique flavonoid with potent antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, as well as other flavonoids, phenolic acids, and aspalathic acid, which contribute to its health-promoting effects.
